title: Blind Discovery: Chicane Obstacle Traversal
goal_description: Discover control parameters enabling smooth traversal through chicane obstacles without timeout or collision.

hypotheses.title: Increase Tangential Gain to Enhance Maneuverability
hypotheses.statement: By increasing the tangential gain, the robot will be more responsive to the need to turn around the chicane obstacles, potentially leading to a smoother traversal.
hypotheses.mechanism: The tangential gain affects how the robot adjusts its direction in response to the proximity of obstacles.

hypotheses.title: Reduce Safety Margin to Allow Closer Proximity to Obstacles
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to get closer to the obstacles, potentially enabling it to make tighter turns and avoid stalling.
hypotheses.mechanism: The safety margin defines the minimum distance the robot maintains from obstacles to avoid collisions.

hypotheses.title: Increase Repulsion Gain to Strengthen Obstacle Avoidance
hypotheses.statement: By increasing the repulsion gain, the robot will be more strongly repelled by obstacles, which could help it navigate the chicane more effectively.
hypotheses.mechanism: The repulsion gain influences the strength of the repulsive force applied to the robot when it detects obstacles.
